BJP Leader Mocks SP's 'PDA' Slogan Ahead of UP Polls

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) National General Secretary Vinod Tawde has criticized the Samajwadi Party's (SP) 'PDA' slogan, interpreting it as 'Paraya Dhan Apna' (Someone else's wealth is our own). Tawde's remarks were made in the context of the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The BJP leader's statement is seen as a direct swipe at SP chief Akhilesh Yadav.
